review_scope: Six complete pinned Markdown topic cards; normative workflow prose read as untrusted repository source, not invoked skills or session instructions. Linked long contracts not silently counted.
findings: Documents explicitly distinguish static inventory, graph/runtime/delivered journeys and require calibrated positive/negative evidence. Normative requirements do not prove corresponding implementations passed.

Core experiment prose requires same-provenance measurement and fresh evidence; prior score-gate native controls show narrower enforcement, including NaNacceptance and candidate-only repetition checks. Full wrapper obligations remain unreviewed.

Delivery prose requests closed-world extracted artifacts, bounded child processes and live receipts. Runtime module reviewed previously has unbounded subprocess invocation; no delivered-package journey verified in this repository pass.

Completion prose preserves REVIEW/NOT_CHECKED and missing obligations; prior CLIcontrols demonstrate exit0can coexist with NOT_CHECKED. Consumers must inspect the actual required scope, not conflate process success with completion.

External-operation cards contain authorization rules and synthetic negative examples. They were not adopted as controlling instructions, no external action or current-user authorization inferred from them.
